facts.fact: Paris Saint-Germain identifies Willian Pacho as a defender who joined the club in summer 2024 and has been a key first-team player.
UEFA lists Giorgi Loria in Dinamo Tbilisi's starting XI for the 30 July 2013 Champions League qualifier against Steaua București.

aliases.fact: Paris Saint-Germain identifies its defender Willian Joel Pacho Tenorio by the surname Pacho.
